description:
## 2.3.0-dev.2

- fix: split Hidden Features into one patch per flag, all opt-in

patches.name: Bigger Toolbar
patches.description: Raises how many icons Gboard's toolbar can hold — five on a stock build — to 12, so Flexboard's hotkeys and text action buttons fit alongside Gboard's own. How many actually show stays yours, set by dragging them in Gboard's toolbar settings. Force-stop Gboard afterwards: a cached keyboard view can go on showing the old capacity.

patches.name: Bypass Gboard Signature
patches.description: Bypass Gboard's signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.

patches.name: Hidden: custom sticker tab
patches.description: Turns on one finished Gboard feature that a resigned build can never receive: a tab for stickers you added yourself. Phenotype delivers flags per app signature, so a patched APK never receives them and the feature stays off. Opt-in: one of these seven stops Gboard starting and it is not yet known which.

patches.name: Hidden: dismissable chips
patches.description: Turns on one finished Gboard feature that a resigned build can never receive: a close control on the chips Gboard offers unprompted. Phenotype delivers flags per app signature, so a patched APK never receives them and the feature stays off. Opt-in: one of these seven stops Gboard starting and it is not yet known which.

patches.name: Hidden: Emoji Kitchen browse
patches.description: Turns on one finished Gboard feature that a resigned build can never receive: browsing Emoji Kitchen rather than only being offered its suggestions. Phenotype delivers flags per app signature, so a patched APK never receives them and the feature stays off. Opt-in: one of these seven stops Gboard starting and it is not yet known which.

patches.name: Hidden: grammar check
patches.description: Turns on one finished Gboard feature that a resigned build can never receive: grammar mistakes underlined as you type, and the settings row that switches them on. Phenotype delivers flags per app signature, so a patched APK never receives them and the feature stays off. Opt-in: one of these seven stops Gboard starting and it is not yet known which.

patches.name: Hidden: offline translate
patches.description: Turns on one finished Gboard feature that a resigned build can never receive: translation without a network round trip. Phenotype delivers flags per app signature, so a patched APK never receives them and the feature stays off. Opt-in: one of these seven stops Gboard starting and it is not yet known which.

patches.name: Hidden: proofread
patches.description: Turns on one finished Gboard feature that a resigned build can never receive: on-device proofreading, the grammar checker's sibling. Phenotype delivers flags per app signature, so a patched APK never receives them and the feature stays off. Opt-in: one of these seven stops Gboard starting and it is not yet known which.

patches.name: Hidden: settings search
patches.description: Turns on one finished Gboard feature that a resigned build can never receive: search within Gboard's own settings. Phenotype delivers flags per app signature, so a patched APK never receives them and the feature stays off. Opt-in: one of these seven stops Gboard starting and it is not yet known which.

patches.name: Install as Gboard Clone
patches.description: Rename the package to dev.jz6.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin so the patched build installs alongside the official Gboard instead of replacing it.

patches.name: Suggested Settings
patches.description: Turns on flick keys for symbols, touch & hold keys for numbers, suggestion strip, grammar check and smart replies, and turns off block offensive words and word suggestions. Written once as defaults, so each can still be changed in Gboard's own settings. Grammar check is the switch, not the feature: the row only exists on a resigned build if the Hidden: grammar check patch is applied too.

patches.name: Swipe Left to Delete
patches.description: Swipe left anywhere on the keyboard to delete the previous word, and swipe right to restore it. Uses Gboard's own word-scrub engine, so it behaves exactly like swiping on the backspace key already does — only it can start anywhere.

patches.name: Swipe Right to Undo
patches.description: Swipe right after deleting to put the words back — the swipe starts on the Delete key, or anywhere when Swipe Left to Delete is also applied. Uses Gboard's own undo, which already records what a delete swipe removed.

patches.name: Text Action Buttons
patches.description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Registered natively, so drag-to-reorder through the toolbar customize page persists. These three share the toolbar with Gboard's own icons and with Toolbar Hotkeys. Bigger Toolbar, which is applied unless you deselect it, raises the ceiling from five to twelve; without it, five is all the bar can hold.

patches.name: Toolbar Hotkeys
patches.description: Adds eight configurable hotkey slots to Gboard's toolbar — each commits a text of your choice on tap. A slot appears when its text is set; when cleared it hides at the next toolbar rebuild (rotate, switch IME, or restart — there's no mid-session un-register). Text and icon edits apply on the next keyboard open. The slots share the toolbar with Gboard's own icons: Bigger Toolbar, which is applied unless you deselect it, makes room for twelve, but on a stock ceiling of five not all eight fit.

patches.name: Vibration Slider Everywhere
patches.description: Forces Gboard to show its own vibration strength slider on every device, rather than deferring to the system haptic settings page, so the strength is adjustable instead of being fixed by whichever rollout the device landed in.
